Hi Emma / Miguel,

Thanks again for a great discovery earlier — really helpful to understand the inference surface and business goals. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can lock the dedicated capacity sizing call: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary use: real-time document classification + entity extraction for compliance workflows.
- Expected steady traffic: ~30–70 req/s; expected peak bursts up to ~260 req/s during end-of-day processing.
- Typical payload: avg 1–2 documents / request, median sequence ~300 tokens, 95th ~1,000 tokens.
- Latency target: 95th <= 250ms for simple classification paths; relaxed SLA for long-context extractions (~1s).

Goal for dedicated sizing call
- Validate throughput and latency targets on realistic traffic patterns
- Confirm GPU footprint, preferred quantization profile, and autoscale/burst plan
- Define test harness + runbook for soak test and failover

Proposed next step
- 60-minute dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) where we run through your sample load profile and map to a recommended dedicated pool.
- Proposed windows next week (PDT):
  * Tue 2027-06-08: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
  * Thu 2027-06-10: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00

Pre-call asks (attach/confirm if possible)
- A small sample of typical payloads (anonymized)
- A CSV with hourly traffic for a 7-day period (I attached a throughput-profile-template.csv)
- Any compliance constraints (HIPAA/PCI/SOC2) we should be aware of

I attached a throughput-profile-template.csv and a draft mutual-action-plan.docx to speed prep. If you confirm the preferred window and attendees we’ll lock a calendar invite and include Ben (solutions eng) + Grace (CS) from our side.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
